title: Discovering local white bands that played good jazz
summary: Steinau was surprised to learn that bands from his high school dances played excellent jazz and says he was never a good dancer.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
